scores.claim_text: Archer has a purchase agreement with United Airlines for the conditional purchase of up to $1.0 billion of aircraft, with an option for another $500.0 million; United paid $10.0 million in pre-delivery payments for 100 aircraft in August 2022.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext on UAL CIK=0000100517 for 'Archer Aviation'
scores.M_value: 18 hits across UAL filings (8-K 2021-04-19, 8-K 2022-01-19, multiple 10-Qs through 2024-04-17). 'Midnight aircraft' = 0 phrase hits, but 'Archer Aviation' appears in 18 UAL filings spanning the partnership period.
scores.interpretation: United Airlines independently corroborates the Archer relationship across 18 filings over 3+ years, including the pre-delivery payment period (8-K 2022-01-19). Counterparty disclosure is well above the 1-3 mention PASS threshold; the $10M pre-delivery cash transfer is the kind of operating substance that would be hard to fake.

scores.claim_text: Stellantis is Archer's strategic manufacturing partner; in January 2023 they entered a manufacturing collaboration and strategic funding agreement, with Stellantis to act as contract manufacturer at Covington; Archer drew $95.0M of $150M strategic funding in 2023.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext on Stellantis CIK=0001605484 for 'Archer Aviation' and 'Archer'
scores.M_value: 1 hit on 'Archer Aviation' (Stellantis 20-F 2024-02-22 for FY2023) plus 5 hits on 'Archer' across Stellantis 6-K and 20-F filings (2021, 2022, 2023 H1 results, FY2023 20-F).
scores.interpretation: Stellantis (foreign issuer, files 20-F/6-K) discloses Archer in its FY2023 annual report and H1 2023 press release — exactly when the manufacturing collaboration was announced and the $95M strategic funding drawdowns occurred. For an ADR/foreign issuer the heuristic allows 0-2 mentions = NORMAL; here we see corroboration in the highest-fidelity filing (20-F annual). PASS.

scores.claim_text: In August 2023, Archer entered into two new contracts with the U.S. Air Force worth up to $142.0 million, including aircraft purchases.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for 'Archer Aviation' across all forms (no DoD-counterparty CIK exists in EDGAR; USAF is not an SEC registrant)
scores.M_value: 280 'Archer Aviation' hits across EDGAR; mostly Archer's own filings. USAF/DoD does not file with the SEC, so there is no counterparty registry analog in this catalog. NHTSA covers ground vehicles only (not eVTOL); FAA registries are excluded per cohort guidance.
scores.interpretation: DoD/USAF contract claims have no SEC counterparty filer to corroborate. SAM.gov / USAspending.gov would be the appropriate M-source but is not in this catalog. Per heuristic #5/#6, marking UNVERIFIABLE rather than RED — defense contracts of this size with detailed structure (two contracts, specified deliverables) are the type that get verified through other channels (press releases, congressional testimony) and the existence of the Special Airworthiness Cert + Maker flight tests provides indirect substance.

scores.claim_text: Archer is building a 350,000 sq ft high-volume manufacturing facility in Covington, Newton County, Georgia, designed for up to 650 aircraft per year.
scores.M_value: 1 EPA-registered facility: 'ARCHER AVIATION INC - 249 WILLIAMS RD (GA)', 249 Williams Rd, Covington, NEWTON COUNTY, GA 30014, lat 33.6269 lon -83.8603.
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms Archer Aviation has a registered facility in the specific city (Covington) and county (Newton) disclosed in the 10-K. Even though aircraft assembly is generally NOT EPA-regulated (heuristic #1), a 350K sq ft new-construction site has triggered some FRS registration (likely under a stormwater / construction permit). Strong physical-existence corroboration with address + GPS coordinates.

scores.claim_text: Archer has filed patent applications in the United States and foreign countries; issued patents are claimed to expire between 2040 and 2044, implying a granted patent portfolio centered on eVTOL aircraft, electric propulsion, and flight control technologies.
scores.M_value: 182 total applications, 96 granted patents pre-cutoff. Category counts: aircraft=80, propulsion=74, battery=9, flight_control=7, other=12. Examples: US12377999 'Vibration Attenuation in Flight Control of an Aircraft', US12330524 'High Voltage Battery Charging and Vertiport Operations', US12269580 'Aircraft Load Alleviation'.
scores.interpretation: 96 granted patents far exceeds the n_granted >= 5 PASS threshold (heuristic #8). Distribution heavily concentrated in claimed-category areas (aircraft 83%, propulsion 77% — overlap because patents touch multiple buckets). Title-level inspection shows real eVTOL-specific subject matter (vertiport charging, tilt-rotor flight control, vibration attenuation). Anti-Nikola pattern: substantive IP in the exact areas they claim to differentiate on.

scores.claim_text: Archer operates a production facility in San Jose, California plus offices, R&D, and flight-test facilities in Santa Clara, Mountain View, and Salinas, California.
scores.M_value: 9 EPA-registered Archer Aviation facilities in CA: San Jose HQ (190 W Tasman Dr) + 4 other San Jose sites (10 W Tasman, 77 Rio Robles, 15400 Graham), Santa Clara (3660 Thomas Rd), Mountain View (1090 Terra Bella Ave), Salinas (37 Mortensen Ave + 1585 Moffett St), plus an additional Newark/Alameda site (6969 Clark Ave) not named in the 10-K.
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS independently registers facilities in every CA city named in the 10-K (San Jose, Santa Clara, Mountain View, Salinas) PLUS one additional site (Newark) — over-disclosure of physical footprint relative to filing. Aircraft assembly normally not EPA-regulated, so 9 hits in CA is unusually rich corroboration (likely tied to flight-test fueling, stormwater, or hazardous-materials permits). Strong PASS.
